title: ARQ_P10
description:
Single-family house of T3 typology with a dedicated home office, located in an urban context in Vila Franca de Xira. The house adopts a deliberately introverted stance toward the street, reinforcing privacy and controlling its relationship with the public realm.

The design strategy emerges from a careful reading of site constraints and the client’s intentions, resulting in a solution that is both functional and expressive. The project is structured around a clear and restrained volume, where formal composition becomes a defining element of the house’s identity.

A continuous frame wraps the perimeter of the building, developing as a three-dimensional element that articulates the volume and is punctuated by a white cantilevered mass. This gesture introduces depth and dynamism to the overall composition.

The architectural reading of the house results from a balanced interplay between solid bodies and oblique planes, set against the discipline of a white volume marked by controlled openings. The outcome is a coherent and contemporary architectural language in which form and function are closely integrated.
